title: TrainingAttempt
description: One worker run of one module. Created and completable with zero network connectivity. client_attempt_id is a client-generated UUID and must never be reused (retakes = new attempts). Server score and certificate fields are optional post-sync enrichments and must not be required for offline completion.

schema_version.description: JSON contract version. Distinct from content_version.

client_attempt_id.description: Client-generated UUID. Primary idempotency key for sync. Never reuse, including after failed or abandoned runs.

worker_id.description: Stable worker identifier known on-device. May be provisioned before first online session; not a secret.

content_version.description: Module/rubric pack version actually used during this run. Required for server re-score.

completed_at.description: Required (non-null) when status is completed. Null while in_progress or abandoned without completion.

status.description: in_progress: local only. completed: eligible for outbox sync. abandoned: terminal without a completed assessment; not synced in MVP.

client_score.description: Device-computed score from the bundled rubric. Informational until the server re-scores.

passed.description: Device-computed pass using client_score and module pass_percent. Server may disagree after re-score.

server_attempt_id.description: Optional canonical id assigned after successful sync. Must be absent for purely offline attempts.

server_score.description: Optional canonical score. Must not be required to complete training offline.

certificate_public_id.description: Set only after the server issues a certificate. Local pending drafts must not populate this as a public-valid certificate.
